title: Serve setup wizard — flow notes & microcopy proposals
content:
Purpose:
This doc proposes a lightweight "Serve setup" wizard to make creating a model catalog entry + endpoint + optional version pinning fast and error-resistant for engineers and PMs. The goal: one linear flow for common cases (create catalog entry, choose model version, create endpoint), with an "advanced" path for dedicated/private options, canary rollouts, and quantization selection.

Audience:
- Engineers provisioning hosted endpoints for prototypes
- Platform/infra teams (Dedicated/Private) who need explicit control over capacity and KMS
- Solutions/SEs who help customers set up first endpoints

Assumptions:
- The user already has a model in the catalog or will pick from curated options.
- Most users want sane defaults: latency-focused routing, no pinning (unless they opt in), streaming enabled.
- We must surface cost and expected latency early in flow.

High-level flow (6 steps):
1) Name & scope: human readable name, optional tags, team ownership dropdown
2) Select model: search/catalog picker with previews (sample output + perf profile)
3) Version selection: choose latest or pin a specific version (with explanation)
4) Serve config: route type (hosted/dedicated/private), capacity estimate, streaming, caching toggles
5) Traffic & rollouts: default 100% single model; option for canary or A/B with weights and fallback policies
6) Review & create: show cost estimate, SLA hints, CLI snippet + terraform snippet, confirm

Step-by-step wireframe notes + microcopy (drafts):
1) Name & scope screen
- Title: "Name your endpoint"
- Subtitle: "A clear name helps teams find and manage endpoints. You can tag by product or team."
- Fields: Endpoint name (required), Description (optional), Team (autocomplete), Tags (chips)
- Helper text under name: "Example: `chat-rewrite-service-v1`"
- Primary button: "Next: pick a model"
- Secondary: "Cancel" or "Save draft" (save draft for long flows)

2) Select model screen
- Title: "Choose a model"
- Left: search + filters (latency profile, cost tier, capability: chat/completion/embedding)
- Right: model cards (name, short desc, perf bars: median latency, cost index)
- Card microcopy: "Redwood-7B — balanced: 40ms | $0.003/1k tokens"
- Preview button: "Try sample prompt" opens small modal with sample generation
- Primary button: "Select model" (disabled until a model chosen)

Notes: we should show a tiny "Why this matters" tooltip that compares latest vs pinned (link to modal).

3) Version selection (this is where we diverge from current UI drafts)
- Title: "Which version should we use?"
- Radio options: "Always use latest compatible version (recommended)" and "Pin to specific version"
- If "Pin": show dropdown with versions sorted by release date + badges (stable/beta) and show commit/changelog blurb inline (1 line).
- Microcopy for recommended option: "Auto-updates keep you on the latest performance/bug fixes. Use pinning to avoid behavioral changes."
- Danger CTA text when pinning: "I understand: pinning prevents automatic performance/security updates" (small checkbox)

4) Serve config (defaults + advanced collapse)
- Default collapsed view: Route type: "Hosted" (explain: fastest, pay-as-you-go)
- Advanced expand: Dedicated / Private with fields for capacity, GPU type, region, KMS toggle
- Toggles: Enable streaming (on by default), Enable prefix caching (on by default for prompts with reuse), Logging level (errors only / tokens / full)
- Microcopy for prefix caching: "Cache repeated prefixes to save cost; good for chat sessions."
- Cost indicator: live row with small calc: "Estimate: ~350 tokens/min = $X / hr" (link to full calculator)

5) Traffic & rollback rules
- Default: single model, 100% traffic
- Advanced: create canary + set weight (e.g., 5%) with automatic rollback threshold (error rate spike or latency increase)
- Microcopy: "Canary rollouts help validate behavior on production traffic. Set an automatic rollback rule to protect your SLA."
- Fallback policy selector: prefer lower-latency variant / prefer cheaper variant / custom

6) Review & create
- Big review card per section with edit links (Name, Model, Version, Config, Traffic)
- Buttons: "Create endpoint" and secondary "Generate CLI + Terraform"
- Microcopy confirmation banner: "Endpoint will be live within ~1-2 minutes for hosted; Dedicated may take longer depending on capacity."

Edge states and error copy (short list):
- Model unavailable error: "This model isn't available in the selected region. Choose a different region or model."
- Pin conflict (if model removed): "The version you selected was archived. Pick a different version or select latest."
- Capacity shortage for Dedicated: "Requested capacity exceeds reserved pool. Request quota or choose burst mode."
- Rollout failure: "Canary exceeded thresholds. Traffic reverted to stable version."

Microcopy variants to A/B test (three short examples each):
- Create button: ["Create endpoint", "Launch endpoint", "Deploy now"]
- Version helper: ["Auto-update keeps you current", "Auto-update applies non-breaking fixes", "Auto-update: saves you maintenance"]
- Canary description: ["Small percentage of traffic for validation", "Try changes on real traffic with low exposure", "Safely test new versions on a subset of users"]

Accessibility and keyboard flow notes:
- All actions must be accessible via keyboard only: tab order: Name -> Model search -> Version -> Config toggles -> Traffic -> Review -> Create
- Use clear ARIA labels for model cards (include perf numbers)
- Ensure contrast in small perf bars and badges

Telemetry hooks (minimal list):
- On select model: send model_id, perf_profile_id, user_role
- On pin toggle: send pin_choice, version_id (if pinned)
- On rollout creation: traffic_weights, rollback_rules
- Final create: endpoint_id (generated client-side), estimated_cost_bucket

Backlog grooming table (informal):
- Story: "Serve wizard: basic flow for hosted endpoints"
  - Description: linear flow for common endpoint creation
  - Acceptance: name saved, model selected, endpoint created with default settings, CLI snippet generated
  - Estimate: 5 SP
  - Priority: P0
- Story: "Version pinning modal and warnings"
  - Description: implement pin UI, pin confirmation checkbox, and pin conflict handling
  - Acceptance: user can pin, pinned endpoints do not auto-update; archive warning shown when version unavailable
  - Estimate: 3 SP
  - Priority: P1
- Story: "Canary rollout UI + auto-rollback"
  - Description: create traffic weight input, metric thresholds, automated rollback logic
  - Acceptance: create canary, monitor simple metrics, revert on threshold breach
  - Estimate: 8 SP
  - Priority: P1
- Story: "Dedicated/Private advanced path"
  - Description: extra fields for region/GPU/KMS and capacity estimate; surface capacity warnings
  - Acceptance: user can select Dedicated, capacity validated against pool, KMS toggle saved
  - Estimate: 8 SP
  - Priority: P0 for enterprise onboarding

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Pinning UX: Do we default to "latest" with a banner after creation saying "Pin if you want stable outputs"? Or force explicit opt-in at create time?
- Cost calc: Do we show immediate per-hour estimate always, or only on review? Need finance input for default rates per model.
- Preview: Do we allow sample prompt runs that use real tokens (billable) or mock cheap previews? Security implications for private models.

Next steps (owner: Asha)
- Sync with applied-ml to confirm perf metrics and labels for model cards (Liam) — due EOD Friday
- Build high-fidelity wireframes for steps 2 & 3 (Mina) — next week
- Draft copy variants for onboarding emails and first-run tips (Ruth) — next Tuesday
- Align with SRE on telemetry + rollout auto-rollback implementation (Devon) — in planning meeting

Notes to reviewers:
- This is intentionally prescriptive on defaults to reduce decision fatigue. We want the majority of users to finish flow in <3 minutes.
- Be blunt about what must be in MVP vs what is "advanced".

TODOs (quick):
- [ ] Add CLI/Terraform examples for review screen
- [ ] Confirm wording for pin confirmation checkbox with legal/security (pinning can affect model audits)
- [ ] Add screenshot of existing catalog UI for contrast

End of doc.
